run_masked_img2img: run masked Stable Diffusion XL img2img generation with a prompt, image, and mask for selective inpainting
create_pipeline_masked: create a MaskedStableDiffusionXLImg2ImgPipeline instance with custom blur and sample mode parameters
prepare_latents_masked: prepare latent variables from an input image with configurable sample mode for inpainting or repainting
blur_mask_gaussian: blur a PIL mask image using Gaussian blur and return a normalized tensor for latent masking
convert_latents_to_image: convert denormalized VAE latents back to a PIL image for inspection or saving
